page.overview:
Who is Shrinking Rae?

Kursk Furnace Tether Tyrant Magmaniac Mauler Twins Giant Lizard League

Rachel, better known as Shrinking Rae, is a major character in Invincible, debuting from Season 1 and onwards.

She is a superheroine who can reduce her size to extremely tiny sizes. After the massacre of the original Guardians of the Globe by Omni-Man, she was chosen by Robot to be part of the new version of the Guardians after successfully finishing a challenging audition process. After her close brush with death involving the Lizard League, Rachel started to reassess her life, seeking a purpose beyond being a superhero; she even found herself in a relationship with Rex Splode before his tragic end in the Invincible War.

Rae is a young woman with tan skin, green eyes, brown hair, and a well-toned, athletic physique. She also wears glasses and her hair tied back in a low, effortless ponytail.
